import pytest
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass

class DummyRenderer:
    pass

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label'):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']
        label = context['widget'].get('label')
        return f'tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}'

class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = 'hidden-template'

class DummyField:

    def __init__(self, widget=None, label='Field Label', help_text='help', show_hidden_initial=False, localize=False, required=False, disabled=False, label_suffix=None, hidden_widget_factory=None):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        return f'bound({data}|{initial})'

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        return f'prepared({data})'

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if value == 'RAISE':
            raise ValidationError('bad')
        return f'python({value})'

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        return initial != data

class DummyForm:

    def __init__(self, *, auto_id='id_%s', is_bound=False, label_suffix=':', use_required_attribute=True, errors=None, required_css_class='required', error_css_class='error', renderer=None, initials=None, data_map=None):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.required_css_class = required_css_class
        self.error_css_class = error_css_class
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f'prefix-{name}'

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f'initial-{name}'

    def error_class(self):
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f'initial-{name}')

def make_boundfield(**kwargs):
    form = kwargs.pop('form', DummyForm())
    field = kwargs.pop('field', DummyField())
    name = kwargs.pop('name', 'first_name')
    return (BoundField(form, field, name), form, field)

def test_init_sets_names_label_and_help_text_from_field():
    bf, form, field = make_boundfield()
    assert bf.form is form
    assert bf.field is field
    assert bf.name == 'first_name'
    assert bf.html_name == 'prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.auto_id == 'id_prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.html_initial_name == 'initial-first_name'
    assert bf.html_initial_id == 'initial-id_prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.label == 'Field Label'
    assert bf.help_text == 'help'

def test_init_uses_pretty_name_when_label_is_none():
    field = DummyField(label=None)
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=field, name='user_name')
    assert bf.label == 'User name'

def test_str_renders_widget_only_by_default():
    bf, _, field = make_boundfield()
    result = str(bf)
    assert result == "render:prefix-first_name:prepared(initial-first_name):{'id': 'id_prefix-first_name'}"
    assert len(field.widget.render_calls) == 1

def test_str_renders_widget_and_hidden_initial_when_enabled():
    hidden = HiddenWidget()
    field = DummyField(show_hidden_initial=True, hidden_widget_factory=lambda: hidden)
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=field)
    result = str(bf)
    assert "render:prefix-first_name:prepared(initial-first_name):{'id': 'id_prefix-first_name'}" in result
    assert "render:initial-first_name:prepared(initial-first_name):{'id': 'initial-id_prefix-first_name'}" in result

def test_subwidgets_cached_and_wraps_each_result_in_boundwidget():
    bf, _, field = make_boundfield()
    subwidgets1 = bf.subwidgets
    subwidgets2 = bf.subwidgets
    assert subwidgets1 is subwidgets2
    assert len(subwidgets1) == 2
    assert all((isinstance(w, BoundWidget) for w in subwidgets1))
    assert field.widget.subwidgets_calls == [('prefix-first_name', 'prepared(initial-first_name)', {'id': 'id_prefix-first_name'})]

def test_subwidgets_uses_widget_attr_id_over_auto_id_and_builds_attrs():
    widget = DummyWidget(attrs={'id': 'custom-id'})
    field = DummyField(widget=widget, required=True, disabled=True)
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=field)
    _ = bf.subwidgets
    assert widget.subwidgets_calls[0][2] == {'id': 'custom-id', 'required': True, 'disabled': True}

def test_boundfield_bool_iter_len_getitem_and_slice():
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield()
    assert bool(bf) is True
    assert len(bf) == 2
    assert list(iter(bf)) == bf.subwidgets
    assert bf[0] is bf.subwidgets[0]
    assert bf[:1] == bf.subwidgets[:1]

def test_getitem_rejects_non_integer_or_slice():
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield()
    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as exc:
        _ = bf['x']
    assert str(exc.value) == 'BoundField indices must be integers or slices, not str.'

def test_errors_returns_existing_error_list_or_new_error_class():
    existing = DummyErrorList(['bad'])
    form = DummyForm(errors={'first_name': existing})
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(form=form)
    assert bf.errors is existing
    bf2, _, _ = make_boundfield(form=DummyForm())
    errs = bf2.errors
    assert isinstance(errs, DummyErrorList)
    assert errs == []

def test_as_widget_uses_default_widget_sets_localized_and_auto_id():
    widget = DummyWidget()
    field = DummyField(widget=widget, localize=True)
    bf, form, _ = make_boundfield(field=field)
    result = bf.as_widget()
    assert widget.is_localized is True
    assert result == "render:prefix-first_name:prepared(initial-first_name):{'id': 'id_prefix-first_name'}"
    call = widget.render_calls[-1]
    assert call['renderer'] is form.renderer

def test_as_widget_respects_only_initial_and_existing_widget_id():
    widget = DummyWidget(attrs={'id': 'already'})
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(widget=widget))
    bf.as_widget(only_initial=True)
    call = widget.render_calls[-1]
    assert call['name'] == 'initial-first_name'
    assert call['attrs'] == {}

def test_as_widget_merges_attrs_with_required_and_disabled():
    field = DummyField(required=True, disabled=True)
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=field)
    bf.as_widget(attrs={'class': 'x'})
    call = field.widget.render_calls[-1]
    assert call['attrs'] == {'class': 'x', 'required': True, 'disabled': True, 'id': 'id_prefix-first_name'}

def test_data_property_reads_form_widget_data():
    form = DummyForm(data_map={'prefix-first_name': 'submitted'})
    bf, _, field = make_boundfield(form=form, field=DummyField(widget=DummyWidget()))
    assert bf.data == 'submitted'
    assert form.widget_data_calls == [(field.widget, 'prefix-first_name')]

def test_value_uses_initial_when_unbound():
    bf, _, field = make_boundfield(form=DummyForm(is_bound=False))
    assert bf.value() == 'prepared(initial-first_name)'
    assert field.bound_data_calls == []
    assert field.prepare_value_calls == ['initial-first_name']

def test_value_uses_bound_data_when_form_is_bound():
    form = DummyForm(is_bound=True, data_map={'prefix-first_name': 'posted'})
    field = DummyField()
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(form=form, field=field)

import pytest
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.id_for_label_calls = []
        self.use_required_attribute_calls = []
        self.render_return = '<rendered>'
        self.subwidgets_return = [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'Choice 1'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Choice 2', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]
        self.hidden_widget_instance = None

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        self.render_calls.append({'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer})
        return self.render_return

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append({'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs})
        return list(self.subwidgets_return)

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        self.id_for_label_calls.append(id_)
        return f'label-{id_}' if id_ else ''

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        self.use_required_attribute_calls.append(initial)
        return True

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        return f"rendered:{template_name}:{context['widget']['wrap_label']}:{renderer}"

class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = 'hidden-template'

class NoRequiredWidget(DummyWidget):

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        self.use_required_attribute_calls.append(initial)
        return False

class DummyField:

    def __init__(self, widget=None, label=None, help_text='', show_hidden_initial=False, localize=False, required=False, disabled=False, label_suffix=None):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []
        self.hidden_widget_calls = 0
        self.hidden_widget_instance = HiddenWidget()

    def hidden_widget(self):
        self.hidden_widget_calls += 1
        return self.hidden_widget_instance

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        return f'bound({data}|{initial})'

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        return f'prepared({data})'

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        return f'py({value})'

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        return initial != data

class RaisingToPythonField(DummyField):

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        raise ValidationError('bad')

class ErrorMap(dict):

    def get(self, key, default=None):
        return super().get(key, default)

class DummyForm:

    def __init__(self, *, auto_id='id_%s', is_bound=False, label_suffix=':', use_required_attribute=True, required_css_class='required', error_css_class='error', errors=None, widget_data=None, initial_map=None, renderer='RENDERER'):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.required_css_class = required_css_class
        self.error_css_class = error_css_class
        self.errors = ErrorMap(errors or {})
        self._widget_data = widget_data or {}
        self._initial_map = initial_map or {}
        self.renderer = renderer
        self.error_class_calls = 0
        self.add_prefix_calls = []
        self.add_initial_prefix_calls = []
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        self.add_prefix_calls.append(name)
        return f'prefix-{name}'

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        self.add_initial_prefix_calls.append(name)
        return f'initial-{name}'

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._widget_data.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initial_map.get(name, f'initial-{name}')

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return ['default-error']

def make_boundfield(**kwargs):
    form = kwargs.pop('form', DummyForm())
    field = kwargs.pop('field', DummyField())
    name = kwargs.pop('name', 'first_name')
    return (BoundField(form, field, name), form, field)

def test_init_sets_names_label_and_help_text():
    form = DummyForm()
    field = DummyField(label=None, help_text='')
    bf = BoundField(form, field, 'first_name')
    assert bf.name == 'first_name'
    assert bf.html_name == 'prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.auto_id == 'id_prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.html_initial_name == 'initial-first_name'
    assert bf.html_initial_id == 'initial-id_prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.label == 'First name'
    assert bf.help_text == ''

def test_init_uses_explicit_label_and_help_text():
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(label='Explicit', help_text='Help'))
    assert bf.label == 'Explicit'
    assert bf.help_text == 'Help'

def test_str_renders_widget_only_by_default():
    widget = DummyWidget()
    widget.render_return = 'W'
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(widget=widget))
    assert str(bf) == 'W'

def test_str_renders_widget_and_hidden_initial_when_enabled():
    widget = DummyWidget()
    widget.render_return = 'VISIBLE'
    field = DummyField(widget=widget, show_hidden_initial=True)
    field.hidden_widget_instance.render_return = 'HIDDEN'
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=field)
    assert str(bf) == 'VISIBLEHIDDEN'

def test_subwidgets_cached_and_wraps_boundwidgets():
    widget = DummyWidget()
    bf, form, field = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(widget=widget))
    subs1 = bf.subwidgets
    subs2 = bf.subwidgets
    assert subs1 is subs2
    assert len(subs1) == 2
    assert all((isinstance(s, BoundWidget) for s in subs1))
    assert len(widget.subwidgets_calls) == 1
    call = widget.subwidgets_calls[0]
    assert call['name'] == 'prefix-first_name'
    assert call['value'] == 'prepared(initial-first_name)'
    assert call['attrs']['id'] == 'id_prefix-first_name'

def test_subwidgets_uses_widget_attr_id_over_auto_id_and_build_attrs():
    widget = DummyWidget(attrs={'id': 'custom-id'})
    field = DummyField(widget=widget, required=True, disabled=True)
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=field)
    _ = bf.subwidgets
    call = widget.subwidgets_calls[0]
    assert call['attrs'] == {'id': 'custom-id', 'required': True, 'disabled': True}

def test_bool_iter_len_getitem():
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield()
    assert bool(bf) is True
    assert len(bf) == 2
    assert list(iter(bf)) == bf.subwidgets
    assert bf[0] is bf.subwidgets[0]
    assert bf[0:1] == bf.subwidgets[0:1]

def test_getitem_rejects_non_int_or_slice():
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield()
    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as exc:
        _ = bf['x']
    assert str(exc.value) == 'BoundField indices must be integers or slices, not str.'

def test_errors_returns_existing_errors():
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(form=DummyForm(errors={'first_name': ['e1']}))
    assert bf.errors == ['e1']

def test_errors_returns_default_error_class_when_missing():
    form = DummyForm()
    bf = BoundField(form, DummyField(), 'first_name')
    assert bf.errors == ['default-error']
    assert form.error_class_calls == 1

def test_as_widget_uses_default_widget_and_sets_auto_id():
    widget = DummyWidget()
    widget.render_return = 'OK'
    bf, form, field = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(widget=widget))
    result = bf.as_widget()
    assert result == 'OK'
    call = widget.render_calls[-1]
    assert call['name'] == 'prefix-first_name'
    assert call['value'] == 'prepared(initial-first_name)'
    assert call['attrs']['id'] == 'id_prefix-first_name'
    assert call['renderer'] == form.renderer

def test_as_widget_only_initial_uses_initial_name_and_id():
    widget = DummyWidget()
    bf, _, field = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(widget=widget))
    bf.as_widget(only_initial=True)
    call = widget.render_calls[-1]
    assert call['name'] == 'initial-first_name'
    assert call['attrs']['id'] == 'initial-id_prefix-first_name'

def test_as_widget_does_not_override_existing_widget_id():
    widget = DummyWidget(attrs={'id': 'present'})
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(widget=widget))
    bf.as_widget()
    call = widget.render_calls[-1]
    assert 'id' not in call['attrs']

def test_as_widget_localizes_widget():
    widget = DummyWidget()
    field = DummyField(widget=widget, localize=True)
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=field)
    bf.as_widget()
    assert widget.is_localized is True

def test_as_hidden_uses_hidden_widget():
    field = DummyField()
    field.hidden_widget_instance.render_return = 'H'
    bf, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=field)
    assert bf.as_hidden() == 'H'
    assert field.hidden_widget_calls == 1

def test_data_reads_from_form_widget_data():
    widget = DummyWidget()
    form = DummyForm(widget_data={'prefix-first_name': 'posted'})
    bf = BoundField(form, DummyField(widget=widget), 'first_name')
    assert bf.data == 'posted'
    assert form.widget_data_calls[-1] == (widget, 'prefix-first_name')

def test_value_uses_initial_when_unbound():
    bf, form, field = make_boundfield(form=DummyForm(is_bound=False))
    assert bf.value() == 'prepared(initial-first_name)'
    assert field.bound_data_calls == []

def test_value_uses_bound_data_when_bound():
    form = DummyForm(is_bound=True, widget_data={'prefix-first_name': 'posted'})
    field = DummyField()
    bf = BoundField(form, field, 'first_name')
    assert bf.value() == 'prepared(bound(posted|initial-first_name))'
    assert field.bound_data_calls == [('posted', 'initial-first_name')]

def test_has_changed_without_hidden_initial_uses_initial():

    field = RaisingToPythonField(show_hidden_initial=True)

    settings.configure(
        USE_I18N=False,

    )

import django

django.setup()

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget
from django.forms.widgets import HiddenInput
from django.utils.safestring import SafeString


class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class TemplateRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        attr_text = "".join(f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items())
        value = widget.get("value")
        name = widget.get("name")
        if template_name.endswith("/input.html"):
            input_type = widget.get("type", "text")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="{input_type}" name="{name}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("/textarea.html"):
            return f'<textarea name="{name}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'
        return f"{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"


class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = "hidden-template"


class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or TemplateRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")

    )

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class TemplateRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        attr_text = "".join(f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items())
        value = widget.get("value")
        name = widget.get("name")
        if template_name.endswith("/input.html"):
            input_type = widget.get("type", "text")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="{input_type}" name="{name}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("/textarea.html"):
            return f'<textarea name="{name}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'
        return f"{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"


class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = "hidden-template"


class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or TemplateRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")

import pytest
from django.conf import settings
if not settings.configured:
    settings.configure(USE_I18N=False, SECRET_KEY='test', FORM_RENDERER='django.forms.renderers.DjangoTemplates', TEMPLATES=[{'BACKEND': 'django.template.backends.django.DjangoTemplates', 'APP_DIRS': True}])
import django
django.setup()
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget
from django.forms.widgets import HiddenInput
from django.utils.safestring import SafeString

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass

class TemplateRenderer:

    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context['widget']
        attrs = widget.get('attrs', {})
        attr_text = ''.join((f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items()))
        value = widget.get('value')
        name = widget.get('name')
        if template_name.endswith('/input.html'):
            input_type = widget.get('type', 'text')
            value_attr = '' if value in (None, '') else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="{input_type}" name="{name}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith('/textarea.html'):
            return f'<textarea name="{name}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'
        return f'{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label', subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']
        label = context['widget'].get('label')
        return f'tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}'

class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = 'hidden-template'

class DummyField:

    def __init__(self, widget=None, label='Field Label', help_text='help', show_hidden_initial=False, localize=False, required=False, disabled=False, label_suffix=None, hidden_widget_factory=None, bound_data_func=None, prepare_value_func=None, to_python_func=None, has_changed_func=None):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f'bound({data}|{initial})'

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f'prepared({data})'

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == 'RAISE':
            raise ValidationError('bad')
        return f'python({value})'

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data

class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = 'required'
    error_css_class = 'error'

    def __init__(self, *, auto_id='id_%s', is_bound=False, label_suffix=':', use_required_attribute=True, errors=None, renderer=None, initials=None, data_map=None):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or TemplateRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f'prefix-{name}'

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f'initial-{name}'

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f'initial-{name}')

class NoCssForm(DummyForm):

    @property
    def required_css_class(self):
        raise AttributeError('required_css_class')

    @property
    def error_css_class(self):
        raise AttributeError('error_css_class')

def make_boundfield(**kwargs):
    form = kwargs.pop('form', DummyForm())

import pytest

from django.conf import settings

if not settings.configured:
    settings.configure(
        USE_I18N=False,
        SECRET_KEY="test",
        FORM_RENDERER="django.forms.renderers.DjangoTemplates",
        TEMPLATES=[{"BACKEND": "django.template.backends.django.DjangoTemplates", "APP_DIRS": True}],
    )

import django

django.setup()

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget
from django.forms.widgets import HiddenInput
from django.utils.safestring import SafeString


class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class TemplateRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        attr_text = "".join(f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items())
        value = widget.get("value")
        name = widget.get("name")
        if template_name.endswith("/input.html"):
            input_type = widget.get("type", "text")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="{input_type}" name="{name}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("/textarea.html"):
            return f'<textarea name="{name}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'
        return f"{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"


class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = "hidden-template"


class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or TemplateRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label', subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data or [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        self.render_calls.append({'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer})
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return list(self.subwidgets_data)

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']

class DummyFormRenderer:

        value = widget.get('value')
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/text.html':
            value_attr = f' value="{value}"' if value is not None else ''
            return f'''<input type="text" name="{widget['name']}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'''
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/textarea.html':
            return f'''<textarea name="{widget['name']}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'''
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/hidden.html':
            value_attr = f' value="{value}"' if value is not None else ''

class TemplateRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        attr_text = "".join(f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items())
        value = widget.get("value")
        name = widget.get("name")
        if template_name.endswith("/input.html"):
            input_type = widget.get("type", "text")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="{input_type}" name="{name}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("/textarea.html"):
            return f'<textarea name="{name}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'
        return f"{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or TemplateRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")


class NoCssForm(DummyForm):
    @property

    @property
    def error_css_class(self):

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass

class TemplateRenderer:

    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context['widget']
        attrs = widget.get('attrs', {})
        attr_text = ''.join((f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items()))
        value = widget.get('value')
        name = widget.get('name')
        if template_name.endswith('/input.html'):
            input_type = widget.get('type', 'text')
            value_attr = '' if value in (None, '') else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="{input_type}" name="{name}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith('/textarea.html'):
            return f'<textarea name="{name}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'
        return f'{template_name}:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label', subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']
        label = context['widget'].get('label')
        return f'tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}'

class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = 'hidden-template'

class DummyField:

    def __init__(self, widget=None, label='Field Label', help_text='help', show_hidden_initial=False, localize=False, required=False, disabled=False, label_suffix=None, hidden_widget_factory=None, bound_data_func=None, prepare_value_func=None, to_python_func=None, has_changed_func=None):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f'bound({data}|{initial})'

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f'prepared({data})'

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == 'RAISE':
            raise ValidationError('bad')
        return f'python({value})'

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data

class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = 'required'
    error_css_class = 'error'

    def __init__(self, *, auto_id='id_%s', is_bound=False, label_suffix=':', use_required_attribute=True, errors=None, renderer=None, initials=None, data_map=None):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or TemplateRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f'prefix-{name}'

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f'initial-{name}'

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):

from django.conf import settings
if not settings.configured:
    settings.configure(USE_I18N=False, SECRET_KEY='test', INSTALLED_APPS=[])
import django
django.setup()
import pytest
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget
from django.forms.widgets import HiddenInput, TextInput, Textarea

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass

class DummyRenderer:
    pass

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label', subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data or [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        self.render_calls.append({'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer})
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return list(self.subwidgets_data)

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']
        label = context['widget'].get('label')
        return f'tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}'

class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = 'hidden-template'

class RecordingHiddenWidget(HiddenInput):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.calls = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        self.calls.append({'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer})
        return super().render(name, value, attrs=attrs, renderer=renderer)

class DummyFormRenderer:

    def render(self, template_name, context):
        widget = context['widget']
        attrs = widget.get('attrs', {})
        attr_text = ''.join((f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items()))
        value = widget.get('value')
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/text.html':
            value_attr = f' value="{value}"' if value is not None else ''
            return f'''<input type="text" name="{widget['name']}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'''
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/textarea.html':
            return f'''<textarea name="{widget['name']}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'''
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/hidden.html':
            value_attr = f' value="{value}"' if value is not None else ''
            return f'''<input type="hidden" name="{widget['name']}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'''
        return f'rendered:{template_name}:{widget}'

class DummyField:

    def __init__(self, widget=None, label='Field Label', help_text='help', show_hidden_initial=False, localize=False, required=False, disabled=False, label_suffix=None, hidden_widget_factory=None, bound_data_func=None, prepare_value_func=None, to_python_func=None, has_changed_func=None):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func or (lambda data, initial: f'bound({data}|{initial})')
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func or (lambda data: f'prepared({data})')
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func or (lambda value: f'python({value})')
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func or (lambda initial, data: initial != data)
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        return self._prepare_value_func(data)

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        return self._to_python_func(value)

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)

class DummyForm:

    def __init__(self, *, auto_id='id_%s', is_bound=False, label_suffix=':', use_required_attribute=True, errors=None, renderer=None, initials=None, data_map=None):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
    required_css_class = 'required'
    error_css_class = 'error'

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f'prefix-{name}'

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f'initial-{name}'

    def error_class(self):
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f'initial-{name}')

def make_boundfield(**kwargs):
    form = kwargs.pop('form', DummyForm())
    field = kwargs.pop('field', DummyField())
    name = kwargs.pop('name', 'first_name')
    return (BoundField(form, field, name), form, field)

def test_init_and_basic_properties():
    bf, form, field = make_boundfield()
    assert bf.form is form
    assert bf.field is field
    assert bf.name == 'first_name'
    assert bf.html_name == 'prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.auto_id == 'id_prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.html_initial_name == 'initial-first_name'
    assert bf.html_initial_id == 'initial-id_prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.label == 'Field Label'
    assert bf.help_text == 'help'
    bf2, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(label=None), name='user_name')
    assert bf2.label == 'User name'
    bf3, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(help_text=''))
    assert bf3.help_text == ''

def test_str_rendering_with_and_without_hidden_initial():

import pytest

    settings.configure(
        USE_I18N=False,

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class DummyRenderer:
    pass


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"


class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = "hidden-template"


class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

import pytest
from django.conf import settings
if not settings.configured:
    settings.configure(USE_I18N=False, SECRET_KEY='test', FORM_RENDERER='django.forms.renderers.DjangoTemplates', TEMPLATES=[{'BACKEND': 'django.template.backends.django.DjangoTemplates', 'APP_DIRS': True}])
import django
django.setup()
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget
from django.forms.widgets import HiddenInput
from django.utils.safestring import SafeString

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass

class DummyRenderer:
    pass

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label', subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']
        label = context['widget'].get('label')
        return f'tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}'

class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = 'hidden-template'

class DummyField:

    def __init__(self, widget=None, label='Field Label', help_text='help', show_hidden_initial=False, localize=False, required=False, disabled=False, label_suffix=None, hidden_widget_factory=None, bound_data_func=None, prepare_value_func=None, to_python_func=None, has_changed_func=None):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f'bound({data}|{initial})'

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f'prepared({data})'

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == 'RAISE':
            raise ValidationError('bad')
        return f'python({value})'

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data

class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = 'required'
    error_css_class = 'error'

    def __init__(self, *, auto_id='id_%s', is_bound=False, label_suffix=':', use_required_attribute=True, errors=None, renderer=None, initials=None, data_map=None):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f'prefix-{name}'

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f'initial-{name}'

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f'initial-{name}')

class RealRenderer:

    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context['widget']
        attrs = widget.get('attrs', {})
        order = ['id', 'required', 'name', 'cols', 'rows']
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted((k for k in attrs if k not in used)):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = ' ' + ' '.join(parts) if parts else ''
        if template_name.endswith('text.html') or widget.get('type') == 'text':
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_text = '' if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'''<input type="text" name="{widget['name']}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'''
        if template_name.endswith('hidden.html') or widget.get('type') == 'hidden':
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_text = '' if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'''<input type="hidden" name="{widget['name']}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'''
        if template_name.endswith('textarea.html'):
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_text = '' if value is None else value
            return f'''<textarea name="{widget['name']}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'''
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

class DummyErrorList(list):

class DummyRenderer:

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"

class DummyField:

        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,

    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize

        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
