class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass

class DummyRenderer:
    pass

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label', subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']
        label = context['widget'].get('label')
        return f'tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}'

class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = 'hidden-template'

class DummyField:

    def __init__(self, widget=None, label='Field Label', help_text='help', show_hidden_initial=False, localize=False, required=False, disabled=False, label_suffix=None, hidden_widget_factory=None, bound_data_func=None, prepare_value_func=None, to_python_func=None, has_changed_func=None):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f'bound({data}|{initial})'

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f'prepared({data})'

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == 'RAISE':
            raise ValidationError('bad')
        return f'python({value})'

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data

class DummyForm:

    error_css_class = 'error'

    def __init__(self, *, auto_id='id_%s', is_bound=False, label_suffix=':', use_required_attribute=True, errors=None, renderer=None, initials=None, data_map=None):

class RealRenderer:

    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context['widget']
        attrs = widget.get('attrs', {})
        order = ['id', 'required', 'name', 'cols', 'rows']
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted((k for k in attrs if k not in used)):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = ' ' + ' '.join(parts) if parts else ''
        if template_name.endswith('text.html') or widget.get('type') == 'text':
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_text = '' if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'''<input type="text" name="{widget['name']}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'''
        if template_name.endswith('hidden.html') or widget.get('type') == 'hidden':
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_text = '' if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'''<input type="hidden" name="{widget['name']}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'''
        if template_name.endswith('textarea.html'):
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_text = '' if value is None else value
            return f'''<textarea name="{widget['name']}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'''
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

import pytest

from django.conf import settings

if not settings.configured:
    settings.configure(
        USE_I18N=False,

        TEMPLATES=[{"BACKEND": "django.template.backends.django.DjangoTemplates", "APP_DIRS": True}],
    )

import django

django.setup()

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget
from django.forms.widgets import HiddenInput
from django.utils.safestring import SafeString


class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class DummyRenderer:
    pass


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []
        self.use_required_calls = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        self.use_required_calls.append(initial)
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"

class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)


def make_boundfield(**kwargs):

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label', subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):

        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):

        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']
        label = context['widget'].get('label')

class RealRenderer:

    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context['widget']
        attrs = widget.get('attrs', {})
        order = ['id', 'required', 'name', 'cols', 'rows']
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted((k for k in attrs if k not in used)):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = ' ' + ' '.join(parts) if parts else ''
        if template_name.endswith('text.html') or widget.get('type') == 'text':
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_text = '' if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'''<input type="text" name="{widget['name']}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'''
        if template_name.endswith('hidden.html') or widget.get('type') == 'hidden':
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_text = '' if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'''<input type="hidden" name="{widget['name']}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'''
        if template_name.endswith('textarea.html'):
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_text = '' if value is None else value
            return f'''<textarea name="{widget['name']}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'''
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        if template_name == "django/forms/widgets/text.html":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            id_attr = f' id="{attrs["id"]}"' if "id" in attrs else ""
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_attr}{id_attr}>'
        if template_name == "django/forms/widgets/textarea.html":
            id_attr = f' id="{attrs["id"]}"' if "id" in attrs else ""
            return (
                f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}" cols="40" rows="10"{id_attr}>\n'
                f'{widget.get("value") or ""}</textarea>'
            )
        if template_name == "django/forms/widgets/hidden.html":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            id_attr = f' id="{attrs["id"]}"' if "id" in attrs else ""
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_attr}{id_attr}>'
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected template: {template_name}")


class DummyRenderer:
    pass


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return list(self.subwidgets_data)

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"


class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = "hidden-template"


class RecordingHiddenWidget(HiddenInput):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.calls = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        self.calls.append({"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer})
        return super().render(name, value, attrs=attrs, renderer=renderer)


class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func or (lambda data, initial: f"bound({data}|{initial})")
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func or (lambda data: f"prepared({data})")
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func or (lambda value: f"python({value})")
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func or (lambda initial, data: initial != data)
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        return self._prepare_value_func(data)

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        return self._to_python_func(value)

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)

class RealRenderer:

    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context['widget']
        attrs = widget.get('attrs', {})
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/text.html':
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_attr = '' if value in (None, '') else f' value="{value}"'
            id_attr = f''' id="{attrs['id']}"''' if 'id' in attrs else ''
            return f'''<input type="text" name="{widget['name']}"{value_attr}{id_attr}>'''
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/textarea.html':
            id_attr = f''' id="{attrs['id']}"''' if 'id' in attrs else ''
            return f'''<textarea name="{widget['name']}" cols="40" rows="10"{id_attr}>\n{widget.get('value') or ''}</textarea>'''
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/hidden.html':
            value = widget.get('value')
            value_attr = '' if value in (None, '') else f' value="{value}"'
            id_attr = f''' id="{attrs['id']}"''' if 'id' in attrs else ''
            return f'''<input type="hidden" name="{widget['name']}"{value_attr}{id_attr}>'''
        raise AssertionError(f'Unexpected template: {template_name}')

class DummyRenderer:
    pass

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label', subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data or [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return list(self.subwidgets_data)

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']

        return f'tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}'

from django.conf import settings
if not settings.configured:
    settings.configure(USE_I18N=False, SECRET_KEY='test', INSTALLED_APPS=[])
import django
django.setup()
import pytest
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget
from django.forms.widgets import HiddenInput, TextInput, Textarea

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass

class DummyRenderer:
    pass

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = 'parent-template'

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix='-label', subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data or [{'attrs': {'id': 'sub1'}, 'label': 'One'}, {'attrs': {'id': 'sub2'}, 'label': 'Two', 'template_name': 'child-template'}]
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f'render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}'

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return list(self.subwidgets_data)

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ''
        return f'{id_}{self.id_suffix}'

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context['widget']['wrap_label']
        label = context['widget'].get('label')
        return f'tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}'

class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = 'hidden-template'

class RecordingHiddenWidget(HiddenInput):

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.calls = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        self.calls.append({'name': name, 'value': value, 'attrs': attrs, 'renderer': renderer})
        return super().render(name, value, attrs=attrs, renderer=renderer)

class DummyFormRenderer:

    def render(self, template_name, context):
        widget = context['widget']
        attrs = widget.get('attrs', {})
        attr_text = ''.join((f' {k}="{v}"' for k, v in attrs.items()))
        value = widget.get('value')
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/text.html':
            value_attr = f' value="{value}"' if value is not None else ''
            return f'''<input type="text" name="{widget['name']}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'''
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/textarea.html':
            return f'''<textarea name="{widget['name']}"{attr_text}>\n{value}</textarea>'''
        if template_name == 'django/forms/widgets/hidden.html':
            value_attr = f' value="{value}"' if value is not None else ''
            return f'''<input type="hidden" name="{widget['name']}"{value_attr}{attr_text}>'''
        return f'rendered:{template_name}:{widget}'

class DummyField:

    def __init__(self, widget=None, label='Field Label', help_text='help', show_hidden_initial=False, localize=False, required=False, disabled=False, label_suffix=None, hidden_widget_factory=None, bound_data_func=None, prepare_value_func=None, to_python_func=None, has_changed_func=None):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func or (lambda data, initial: f'bound({data}|{initial})')
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func or (lambda data: f'prepared({data})')
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func or (lambda value: f'python({value})')
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func or (lambda initial, data: initial != data)
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        return self._prepare_value_func(data)

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        return self._to_python_func(value)

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)

class DummyForm:

    def __init__(self, *, auto_id='id_%s', is_bound=False, label_suffix=':', use_required_attribute=True, errors=None, renderer=None, initials=None, data_map=None):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
    required_css_class = 'required'
    error_css_class = 'error'

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f'prefix-{name}'

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f'initial-{name}'

    def error_class(self):
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f'initial-{name}')

def make_boundfield(**kwargs):
    form = kwargs.pop('form', DummyForm())
    field = kwargs.pop('field', DummyField())
    name = kwargs.pop('name', 'first_name')
    return (BoundField(form, field, name), form, field)

def test_init_and_pretty_name_and_help_text():
    bf, form, field = make_boundfield()
    assert bf.form is form
    assert bf.field is field
    assert bf.name == 'first_name'
    assert bf.html_name == 'prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.auto_id == 'id_prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.html_initial_name == 'initial-first_name'
    assert bf.html_initial_id == 'initial-id_prefix-first_name'
    assert bf.label == 'Field Label'
    assert bf.help_text == 'help'
    bf2, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(label=None), name='user_name')
    assert bf2.label == 'User name'
    bf3, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(help_text=''))
    assert bf3.help_text == ''

def test_str_and_as_widget_variants():
    bf, _, field = make_boundfield()
    assert str(bf) == "render:prefix-first_name:prepared(initial-first_name):{'id': 'id_prefix-first_name'}"
    assert len(field.widget.render_calls) == 1
    hidden = HiddenWidget()
    field2 = DummyField(show_hidden_initial=True, hidden_widget_factory=lambda: hidden)
    bf2, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=field2)
    assert str(bf2) == "render:prefix-first_name:prepared(initial-first_name):{'id': 'id_prefix-first_name'}render:initial-first_name:prepared(initial-first_name):{'id': 'initial-id_prefix-first_name'}"
    widget = DummyWidget()
    field3 = DummyField(widget=widget, localize=True)
    bf3, form3, _ = make_boundfield(field=field3)
    assert bf3.as_widget() == "render:prefix-first_name:prepared(initial-first_name):{'id': 'id_prefix-first_name'}"
    assert widget.is_localized is True
    assert widget.render_calls[-1]['renderer'] is form3.renderer
    widget2 = DummyWidget(attrs={'id': 'already'})
    bf4, _, _ = make_boundfield(field=DummyField(widget=widget2))
    bf4.as_widget(only_initial=True)
    assert widget2.render_calls[-1]['name'] == 'initial-first_name'
    assert widget2.render_calls[-1]['attrs'] == {}

def test_subwidgets_cached_iteration_length_getitem_and_widget_id_attrs():

def test_build_widget_attrs_and_as_widget_merging():

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class DummyRenderer:

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"

    ):

        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func

        self.bound_data_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))

    def prepare_value(self, data):

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class DummyRenderer:

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"

        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":

        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

from django.conf import settings

if not settings.configured:

import django

django.setup()

import pytest

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget
from django.forms.widgets import HiddenInput
from django.utils.safestring import SafeString


class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        if template_name == "django/forms/widgets/text.html":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            id_attr = f' id="{attrs["id"]}"' if "id" in attrs else ""
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_attr}{id_attr}>'
        if template_name == "django/forms/widgets/textarea.html":
            id_attr = f' id="{attrs["id"]}"' if "id" in attrs else ""
            return (
                f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}" cols="40" rows="10"{id_attr}>\n'
                f'{widget.get("value") or ""}</textarea>'
            )
        if template_name == "django/forms/widgets/hidden.html":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_attr = "" if value in (None, "") else f' value="{value}"'
            id_attr = f' id="{attrs["id"]}"' if "id" in attrs else ""
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_attr}{id_attr}>'
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected template: {template_name}")


class DummyRenderer:
    pass


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return list(self.subwidgets_data)

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"


class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = "hidden-template"


class RecordingHiddenWidget(HiddenInput):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.calls = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        self.calls.append({"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer})
        return super().render(name, value, attrs=attrs, renderer=renderer)


class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func or (lambda data, initial: f"bound({data}|{initial})")
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func or (lambda data: f"prepared({data})")
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func or (lambda value: f"python({value})")
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func or (lambda initial, data: initial != data)
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        return self._prepare_value_func(data)

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        return self._to_python_func(value)

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)


class DummyForm:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []

    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")


def make_boundfield(**kwargs):
    form = kwargs.pop("form", DummyForm())
    field = kwargs.pop("field", DummyField())
    name = kwargs.pop("name", "first_name")
    return BoundField(form, field, name), form, field

import pytest

from django.conf import settings

if not settings.configured:
    settings.configure(
        USE_I18N=False,

        TEMPLATES=[{"BACKEND": "django.template.backends.django.DjangoTemplates", "APP_DIRS": True}],
    )

django.setup()

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms.boundfield import BoundField, BoundWidget
from django.forms.widgets import HiddenInput
from django.utils.safestring import SafeString


class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class DummyRenderer:
    pass


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"


class HiddenWidget(DummyWidget):
    is_hidden = True
    template_name = "hidden-template"


class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,
        data_map=None,
    ):
        self.auto_id = auto_id
        self.is_bound = is_bound
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self.use_required_attribute = use_required_attribute
        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):
        return f"prefix-{name}"

    def add_initial_prefix(self, name):
        return f"initial-{name}"

    def error_class(self):
        self.error_class_calls += 1
        return DummyErrorList()

    def _widget_data_value(self, widget, html_name):
        self.widget_data_calls.append((widget, html_name))
        return self._data_map.get(html_name)

    def get_initial_for_field(self, field, name):
        self.initial_calls.append((field, name))
        return self._initials.get(name, f"initial-{name}")

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)


def make_boundfield(**kwargs):
    form = kwargs.pop("form", DummyForm())
    field = kwargs.pop("field", DummyField())
    name = kwargs.pop("name", "first_name")
    return BoundField(form, field, name), form, field

    assert bf.html_initial_name == "initial-first_name"

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},

        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class DummyRenderer:

class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []
        self.use_required_calls = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        self.use_required_calls.append(initial)
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"

class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class DummyRenderer:
    pass


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []
        self.use_required_calls = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        self.use_required_calls.append(initial)
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"

        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required

        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)

        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)

import pytest

from django.conf import settings

if not settings.configured:
    settings.configure(
        USE_I18N=False,

class DummyErrorList(list):
    pass


class DummyRenderer:
    pass


class DummyWidget:
    is_hidden = False
    template_name = "parent-template"

    def __init__(self, attrs=None, use_required=True, id_suffix="-label", subwidgets_data=None):
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.is_localized = False
        self._use_required = use_required
        self.id_suffix = id_suffix
        self.subwidgets_data = subwidgets_data
        self.render_calls = []
        self.subwidgets_calls = []
        self.rendered_templates = []
        self.use_required_calls = []

    def render(self, name, value, attrs=None, renderer=None):
        call = {"name": name, "value": value, "attrs": attrs, "renderer": renderer}
        self.render_calls.append(call)
        return f"render:{name}:{value}:{attrs}"

    def subwidgets(self, name, value, attrs=None):
        self.subwidgets_calls.append((name, value, attrs))
        return self.subwidgets_data or [
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub1"}, "label": "One"},
            {"attrs": {"id": "sub2"}, "label": "Two", "template_name": "child-template"},
        ]

    def use_required_attribute(self, initial):
        self.use_required_calls.append(initial)
        return self._use_required

    def id_for_label(self, id_):
        if not id_:
            return ""
        return f"{id_}{self.id_suffix}"

    def _render(self, template_name, context, renderer):
        self.rendered_templates.append((template_name, context, renderer))
        wrap = context["widget"]["wrap_label"]
        label = context["widget"].get("label")
        return f"tmpl:{template_name}:wrap={wrap}:label={label}"

class DummyField:
    def __init__(
        self,
        widget=None,
        label="Field Label",
        help_text="help",
        show_hidden_initial=False,
        localize=False,
        required=False,
        disabled=False,
        label_suffix=None,
        hidden_widget_factory=None,
        bound_data_func=None,
        prepare_value_func=None,
        to_python_func=None,
        has_changed_func=None,
    ):
        self.widget = widget or DummyWidget()
        self.label = label
        self.help_text = help_text
        self.show_hidden_initial = show_hidden_initial
        self.localize = localize
        self.required = required
        self.disabled = disabled
        self.label_suffix = label_suffix
        self._hidden_widget_factory = hidden_widget_factory or (lambda: HiddenWidget())
        self._bound_data_func = bound_data_func
        self._prepare_value_func = prepare_value_func
        self._to_python_func = to_python_func
        self._has_changed_func = has_changed_func
        self.bound_data_calls = []
        self.prepare_value_calls = []
        self.to_python_calls = []
        self.has_changed_calls = []

    def hidden_widget(self):
        return self._hidden_widget_factory()

    def bound_data(self, data, initial):
        self.bound_data_calls.append((data, initial))
        if self._bound_data_func:
            return self._bound_data_func(data, initial)
        return f"bound({data}|{initial})"

    def prepare_value(self, data):
        self.prepare_value_calls.append(data)
        if self._prepare_value_func:
            return self._prepare_value_func(data)
        return f"prepared({data})"

    def to_python(self, value):
        self.to_python_calls.append(value)
        if self._to_python_func:
            return self._to_python_func(value)
        if value == "RAISE":
            raise ValidationError("bad")
        return f"python({value})"

    def has_changed(self, initial, data):
        self.has_changed_calls.append((initial, data))
        if self._has_changed_func:
            return self._has_changed_func(initial, data)
        return initial != data


class DummyForm:
    required_css_class = "required"
    error_css_class = "error"

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auto_id="id_%s",
        is_bound=False,
        label_suffix=":",
        use_required_attribute=True,
        errors=None,
        renderer=None,
        initials=None,

    ):

        self.label_suffix = label_suffix

        self.errors = errors or {}
        self.renderer = renderer or DummyRenderer()
        self._initials = initials or {}
        self._data_map = data_map or {}
        self.widget_data_calls = []
        self.initial_calls = []
        self.error_class_calls = 0

    def add_prefix(self, name):

class RealRenderer:
    def render(self, template_name, context, request=None):
        widget = context["widget"]
        attrs = widget.get("attrs", {})
        order = ["id", "required", "name", "cols", "rows"]
        parts = []
        used = set()
        for key in order:
            if key in attrs:
                value = attrs[key]
                if value is True:
                    parts.append(key)
                elif value is False or value is None:
                    pass
                else:
                    parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
                used.add(key)
        for key in sorted(k for k in attrs if k not in used):
            value = attrs[key]
            if value is True:
                parts.append(key)
            elif value is False or value is None:
                continue
            else:
                parts.append(f'{key}="{value}"')
        attr_text = (" " + " ".join(parts)) if parts else ""

        if template_name.endswith("text.html") or widget.get("type") == "text":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="text" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("hidden.html") or widget.get("type") == "hidden":
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else f' value="{value}"'
            return f'<input type="hidden" name="{widget["name"]}"{value_text}{attr_text}>'
        if template_name.endswith("textarea.html"):
            value = widget.get("value")
            value_text = "" if value is None else value
            return f'<textarea name="{widget["name"]}"{attr_text}>\n{value_text}</textarea>'
        raise AssertionError(template_name)
